AutoMode.description: How a part treats its automation.

oneOf.description: The lanes play; moving a control writes nothing.

A control writes while it is held or being moved, and the lane
takes over again when it is let go.
A control writes from when it is first moved until the song stops.

Everything the part's lanes move is written over from where the
song starts playing until it stops, moved or not.
The lanes are kept but do not play.

Clip.description:
`paw.api.clip_get(id)` and each entry of `clip_list`, without the notes.
MIDI clips have `note_count`, `control_count` and the stamps, which
change when the notes or controls do; audio clips have `file` and how
they play it, and `edits`, the number of edits. What does not apply to
its kind is left out.

control_stamp.description: The same for the controller moves.

link.description:
A linked clip's link, and how many clips it has (`link_count` only
from `clip_get`).

modifiers.description: A MIDI clip's modifiers, top to bottom (`model/modifiers.rs`).

ClipChanges.description:
What `paw.api.clip_set` changes in a clip: each field as `clip_get`
gives it, and what is left out stays. Nil clears a field that has a
default (`clip_set(id, "loop_length", nil)`), and is refused for the
others.

fade_in.description: Beats an audio clip fades in over.

fade_out.description: Beats an audio clip fades out over.

file.description: The sound file of an audio clip: another take of it.

formants.description: An audio clip keeps the formants of the voice when it is shifted.

gain.description: The gain of an audio clip in dB, from -120 to 24.

length.description: The length of the clip in beats.

loop.description: The clip repeats over its length.

loop_length.description: Beats of one repeat; nil for the clip's content.

loop_start.description: Where a repeat starts in the clip's content, in beats.

modifiers.description:
The modifiers of a MIDI clip, top to bottom. Nil or an empty list
takes all of them away.

offset.description:
Where an audio clip starts in its file, in seconds, or where a
clip of another kind starts in its content.

part.description: Move the clip to the end of this part.

pitch.description: Semitones an audio clip is shifted by.

source_tempo.description: The tempo that an audio clip was recorded at.

start.description: Where the clip starts on the timeline, in beats.

stretch.description: How many times its length an audio clip is stretched to.

warp.description: The markers of an audio clip; the `beat` of each is not read.

Control.description:
A controller moving to a value at a point in a MIDI clip: a control
change, the pitch wheel, pressure, a registered or assignable controller,
or a program change. With `key` it belongs to the note on that key
alone, as MIDI 2.0 has it: that note's own pitch bend, pressure or
controller.

oneOf.description:
A control change by number: 1 is the modulation wheel, 64 the
sustain pedal. With a key, the registered per-note controller of
that number.
A registered controller (RPN) by bank and index; per note, by index.
An assignable controller (NRPN) by bank and index; per note, by index.
Choose a sound, with its bank (fourteen bits) if that is given.

start.description:
Beats from the start of the clip; below 0 it is hidden before the
clip's start and not played.

value.description:
0 to 1, or -1 to 1 for pitch bend. Kept as a fraction, so nothing of
a 32-bit value is lost.

editor.description: Whether its own window shows; nil for a device with no window.

index.description: Its place in the chain of its part, from 1.

missing.description: Not running: not installed, not made yet, or made and gone.

outputs.description:
The part that each further output pair plays into, by the pair's
number as text.

overrides.description:
The parameters that the project sets, over what the plugin's state
says.

params.description: The value now of each parameter, by key.

plugin.description:
Who made it and which it is, as its format names it; nil for a
device of paw.

stopped.description:
Why the device has stopped working, for a plugin that crashed, hung
or could not be made.

DeviceChanges.description:
What `paw.api.device_set` changes in a device: each field as
`device_get` gives it, and what is left out stays.

offline.description: The device is not made: it keeps its state and plays nothing.

outputs.description:
The part that each further output pair plays into, by the
pair's number from 2; nil or an empty table for none.

sidechain.description: The part it listens to; nil for none.

sidechain_pre.description: It listens to the side-chain before the fader of its part.

state.description:
The plugin's state in base64, as `device_state` gives it; nil for
none.

DevicePlugin.description: Who made a plugin and which it is.

DevicePorts.description: What a running device takes and gives besides its main pair.

outputs.description: The names of its output pairs, the main one first.

DeviceStatus.description: Whether a device runs, and why not.

oneOf.description: Being made apart (session/loading.rs).
Set so: not made at all.
Not installed.

EditorState.description: Whether a device's own window shows.

gives.description: The stream that the clips of a clip kind give to their lane.

owner.description: The extension that defined the kind, or `paw.<feature>` for the core.

schema.description:
The words of each field of the data of the kind (of a stream kind:
of each property). Nil when the kind gave none.

version.description: The version of the data of a `meta` key.

writable.description: A tool may write the data of the kind: the kind gave a schema.

Lane.description: A lane as `paw.api.lane_get` gives it, without its points.

device.description: The device of a parameter or state lane.

enabled.description: A lane that is off keeps its points but does not move its target.

max.description: The highest value of the target.

min.description: The lowest value of the target.

param.description: The key of the parameter of a parameter lane.

states.description: The names of the states of a state lane.

enabled.description: A lane that is off keeps its points but does not move its target.

MidiInput.description: MIDI from one port, by its name, and optionally one channel of it.

channel.description: From 1 to 16, or `None` for every channel.

port.description:
The port's name as the system gives it (`paw.midi.inputs()`), or
`None` for every port.

MidiOutForm.description:
What a MIDI output sends where the port takes no MIDI 2.0 (see
`paw_types::midi_form`).

oneOf.description: MIDI 2.0 where the port takes it, else plain MIDI 1.0.
MIDI 1.0 as each message has it.
MIDI Polyphonic Expression: a channel to each note.
Control changes 0 to 31 in fourteen bits.

MidiOutput.description:
MIDI to one output port, by its name, on a channel or on each
message's own, in a form for ports that take no MIDI 2.0.

channel.description: From 1 to 16, or `None` for the channel each message has.

members.description: The member channels of an MPE zone, 1 to 15; `None` for 15.

port.description: The port's name as `paw.midi.outputs()` gives it.

Modifier.description:
One modifier of a clip's stack: its kind, its values, whether it is off,
the beats that it changes, and the version of its values.

kind.description: `transpose`, `velocity`, or a kind of an extension.

off.description:
The entry is off and changes nothing. The file leaves `off` out for
an entry that is on.

params.description:
The values of the kind, as the file has them. The file leaves
`params` out when there are none.

scope.description:
The beats of the clip that the entry changes. Left out, the entry
changes all of the clip.

version.description: The version of the kind's values; left out for 1.

ModifierScope.description:
The beats of a clip, from `from` up to `to`, in which an entry changes
the notes and the controller moves that start there.

NestId.description:
A nest's own id, never reused in the project. Nests take their ids from
the same counter as parts and clips.

NestPlay.description: What a nest clip plays of its nest.

oneOf.description:
The events of one part of the nest, through the devices of the
part the clip is on.
The nest's mix: what its master plays.

attr.description:
The MIDI 2.0 attribute its note-on carries, such as an articulation
of the orchestral articulation profile (M2-123); `None` for none.

id.description:
What names the note within its clip for as long as it lives, however
it is moved or changed (`paw://clip/7/note/41`). 0 until the session
gives it one, which it does to every note that has none, or shares
one with a note before it, before the edit is played or kept.

lyric.description:
The words sung on the note, as plain text: a syllable, a word, or a
phrase. A MIDI file keeps it as a lyric event at the note's start.

meta.description:
Free-form data for extensions, such as the phonemes of a voice. It
travels with the note through edits, unlike data kept beside the
clip's note list.

pitch.description: MIDI note number, 60 is middle C.

start.description:
Beats from the start of the clip. A note before 0 (or from the clip's
length on) is hidden by a trim of the clip's edge: kept, but not
played until the edge is dragged out over it again.

NoteAttr.description:
A note's MIDI 2.0 attribute: `{ "type": 17, "data": 40960 }`. Type 0
means none, and a note never keeps it.

ParamInfo.description: A parameter of a device, as `param_info` lists it.

automated.description: A lane of the part moves it.

choices.description: The names of its steps, for a parameter of named steps.

id.description: The device's own id for it, or its key.

index.description: Its place in the device's list, from 1.

key.description: The key that scripts and lanes name it by.

steps.description: The number of its steps; 0 for a continuous one.

text.description: Its value now as the device writes it (`device_param`).

ParamKind.description: What kind of value a parameter takes.

oneOf.description: Off or on.
Named steps.
Whole steps.

ParamSchema.description: What a parameter takes, as JSON Schema words.

ascending.description: Each number of a list is greater than the one before it.

format.description:
`note` for a note value such as `1/4`. Other formats are only for
people, as in JSON Schema.

items.description: What each number of a list takes.

main.description:
The source is the main input of its kind: a wire with no port
feeds it.

stream.description: The kind of stream that a source must give. None takes any.

unit.description: The unit of a number, and of `minimum`, `maximum` and `default`.

ParamType.description: The type of a parameter: a JSON Schema type, or `source`.

oneOf.description: A number with no fraction.
A text, one of an `enum`, or a note value with `format: "note"`.
A list of numbers, each as its `items` says.
Where a signal comes from: `@id`, `@in`, `@"path"` or a word.

Part.description:
`paw.api.part_get(id)`. `volume` in dB, `pan` -1 to 1, `output` the
part it feeds (nil for the master), `index` from 1 among all parts.
`devices` and `clips` are ids.

chain_origin.description: The chain file outside the project that the chain was copied from.

chain_source.description: A chain read from a chain file outside the project's folder.

kind.description:
The kind of the part (`paw.kinds.define("part", ...)`); nil for
an ordinary part.

listens.description: The parts that devices on this one listen to as side-chains.

nest.description: The subproject that the part belongs to; nil for the song's.

origin.description: The part folder outside the project that the part was copied from.

pairs_into.description: The parts that further output pairs of its devices play into.

parent.description: The group that the part is in; nil at the top level.

source.description: A part read from a part folder outside the project's folder.

PartChanges.description:
What `paw.api.part_set` changes in a part: each field as `part_get`
gives it, and what is left out stays. Nil clears a field that can be
empty (`part_set(id, "output", nil)`), and is refused for the others.

armed.description: The part records when the song records.

attr_map.description:
How the MIDI 2.0 attributes of its notes reach an instrument that
does not take them. Nil, false or an empty table for none.

automation.description:
What a move of a control does to the part's automation while the
song plays.

height.description:
A share of the height of every part, from a quarter to eight
times; nil or 1 for that height.

input.description:
An audio input: a channel such as "1", a pair such as "1/2", or
nil or "none" for none.

kind.description:
The kind of the part: the name of a part kind, or nil for an
ordinary part. A kind that no extension defines is kept.

midi_input.description:
The MIDI the part plays when armed: a port's name, a table of
`port` and `channel`, or nil or "all" for every port.

midi_output.description:
Where the part sends MIDI: a port's name, a table of `port`,
`channel`, `form` and `members`, or nil or "none" for none.

monitor.description: Hear the input even when the part is not armed.

output.description: The part it feeds; nil for the master.

parent.description:
The group that the part is in, or nil for the top level. A group
cannot be put inside itself.

sends.description: Its sends, each with a `level` in dB.

volume.description: The fader in dB, from -120 to 24.

edits.description:
Goes up with each change: compare two readings to see whether
something in between edited the project.

key.description: The song's key, such as "D minor".

length.description: The end of the last clip, in beats.

modified.description: The project has changes that are not saved.

path.description: The project's file; nil before it is saved.

tempo.description: Beats (quarter notes) per minute at the start of the song.

tempo_ramp.description: The tempo ramps from the start to the first tempo change.

tempo_stamp.description:
A hash of the tempo and signature points, the same for the same
points (after an undo too).

ProjectChanges.description:
What `paw.api.project_set` changes in the project: each field as
`project_get` gives it, and what is left out stays.

export.description: The project's export presets by name.

key.description: The song's key, such as "D minor"; nil for none.

sig_den.description:
The lower number of the time signature at the start: 1, 2, 4,
8, 16, 32 or 64.

sig_num.description: The upper number of the time signature at the start, 1 to 64.

tempo.description: The tempo at the start, from 1 to 999 beats per minute.

PropValue.description: The value of a property of a stream.

pre.description:
Taken after the part's devices but before its fader, pan and mute,
so that the send does not follow the fader.

SigChange.description: A time signature starting a bar at a beat.

Stack.description:
The modifiers of a clip, top to bottom: the first entry changes the
notes first.

StretchMode.description: How an audio clip is stretched.

TempoChange.description: A tempo change along the song.

ramp.description: Ramp to the next change's tempo instead of holding this one.

Timebase.description:
What an audio clip keeps when the tempo changes. Either way it keeps its
length in seconds, so that a recording plays every sample at the time
it was recorded at: its end beat follows from the tempo map.

oneOf.description:
Its start stays at the same time in seconds (REAPER's default for
audio items), moving in beats when the tempo before it changes.
Its start stays on its beat.

Its start and its length stay on their beats: the sound is
stretched to fit, from the tempo it is at (`source_tempo`).

Transport.description: The transport as Lua reads it (`paw.api.transport_get`).

closing.description:
Takes that stopped and are not clips yet: each becomes clips a
moment after it stops (`transport.recorded`).

take.description: The number of the take being recorded.

TransportChanges.description:
What `paw.api.transport_set` changes in the transport: each field as
`transport_get` gives it, and what is left out stays.

click_level.description: The click's level, from -60 to 12 dB.

click_output.description:
The output channel of the click, from 1 to 64, or 0 for with the
song.

count_in.description: Bars of count-in before a recording, 0 to 16.

pre_roll.description: Bars that play before the start of playback, 0 to 16.

pre_roll_seconds.description: Seconds that play before the start of playback, 0 to 30.

record_offset.description:
Milliseconds that a recorded take moves to make up for the
latency of the input.

write.description: Moves of the controls write automation while the song plays.

Unit.description: A unit that a number can have in the text.

Velocity.description:
The velocity of a note, 1 to 127, and 100 by default. The files write
it as a plain number. The check of a project (`check_notes`) refuses a
velocity above 127.

WarpMarker.description:
A warp marker of an audio clip: moments of its file in seconds; in a
clip's view, with the `beat` it plays on.
